verses.en: And in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplied, there arose a murmuring of the Grecians against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily ministration.
verses.pt: Ora, naqueles dias, crescendo o número dos discípulos, houve uma murmuração dos helenistas contra os hebreus, porque as viúvas daqueles estavam sendo esquecidas na distribuição diária.
verses.en_web: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.
verses.en_bbe: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was increasing, protests were made by the Greek Jews against the Hebrews, because their widows were not taken care of in the distribution of food every day.

verses.en: Then the twelve called the multitude of the disciples unto them, and said, It is not reason that we should leave the word of God, and serve tables.
verses.pt: E os doze, convocando a multidão dos discípulos, disseram: Não é razoável que nós deixemos a palavra de Deus e sirvamos às mesas.
verses.en_web: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.
verses.en_bbe: And the Apostles sent for all the disciples and said, It is not right for us to give up preaching the word of God in order to make distribution of food.

verses.en: Wherefore, brethren, look ye out among you seven men of honest report, full of the Holy Ghost and wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
verses.pt: Escolhei, pois, irmãos, dentre vós, sete homens de boa reputação, cheios do Espírito Santo e de sabedoria, aos quais encarreguemos deste serviço.
verses.en_web: Therefore select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.
verses.en_bbe: Take then from among you seven men of good name, full of the Spirit and of wisdom, to whom we may give control of this business.

verses.en: But we will give ourselves continually to prayer, and to the ministry of the word.
verses.pt: Mas nós perseveraremos na oração e no ministério da palavra.
verses.en_web: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”
verses.en_bbe: Then we will give all our time to prayer and the teaching of the word.

verses.en: And the saying pleased the whole multitude: and they chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Ghost, and Philip, and Prochorus, and Nicanor, and Timon, and Parmenas, and Nicolas a proselyte of Antioch:
verses.pt: O parecer agradou a todos, e elegeram a Estevão, homem cheio de fé e do Espírito Santo, Filipe, Prócoro, Nicanor, Timão, Pármenas, e Nicolau, prosélito de Antioquia,
verses.en_web: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch;
verses.en_bbe: And this saying was pleasing to all of them: and they made selection of Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, and Philip and Prochorus and Nicanor and Timon and Parmenas and Nicolas of Antioch, who had become a Jew:

verses.en: Whom they set before the apostles: and when they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
verses.pt: e os apresentaram perante os apóstolos; estes, tendo orado, lhes impuseram as mãos.
verses.en_web: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.
verses.en_bbe: These they took to the Apostles, who, after prayer, put their hands on them.

verses.en: And the word of God increased; and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem greatly; and a great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
verses.pt: E divulgava-se a palavra de Deus, de sorte que se multiplicava muito o número dos discípulos em Jerusalém e muitos sacerdotes obedeciam à fé.
verses.en_web: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem exceedingly. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.
verses.en_bbe: And the word of God was increasing in power; and the number of the disciples in Jerusalem became very great, and a great number of priests were in agreement with the faith.

verses.en: And Stephen, full of faith and power, did great wonders and miracles among the people.
verses.pt: Ora, Estêvão, cheio de graça e poder, fazia prodígios e grandes sinais entre o povo.
verses.en_web: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.
verses.en_bbe: And Stephen, full of grace and power, did great wonders and signs among the people.

verses.en: Then there arose certain of the synagogue, which is called the synagogue of the Libertines, and Cyrenians, and Alexandrians, and of them of Cilicia and of Asia, disputing with Stephen.
verses.pt: Levantaram-se, porém, alguns que eram da sinagoga chamada dos libertos, dos cireneus, dos alexandrinos, dos da Cilícia e da Ásia, e disputavam com Estêvão;
verses.en_web: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.
verses.en_bbe: But some of those who were of the Synagogue named that of the Libertines, and some of the men of Cyrene and of Alexandria and those from Cilicia and Asia, had arguments with Stephen.

verses.en: And they were not able to resist the wisdom and the spirit by which he spake.
verses.pt: e não podiam resistir à sabedoria e ao Espírito com que falava.
verses.en_web: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.
verses.en_bbe: But they were not able to get the better of him, for his words were full of wisdom and of the Spirit.

verses.en: Then they suborned men, which said, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses, and against God.
verses.pt: Então subornaram uns homens para que dissessem: Temo-lo ouvido proferir palavras blasfemas contra Moisés e contra Deus.
verses.en_web: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”
verses.en_bbe: Then they got men to say, He has said evil against Moses and against God, in our hearing.

verses.en: And they stirred up the people, and the elders, and the scribes, and came upon him, and caught him, and brought him to the council,
verses.pt: Assim excitaram o povo, os anciãos, e os escribas; e investindo contra ele, o arrebataram e o levaram ao sinédrio;
verses.en_web: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, and brought him in to the council,
verses.en_bbe: And the people, with the rulers and the scribes, were moved against him, and they came and took him before the Sanhedrin,

verses.en: And set up false witnesses, which said, This man ceaseth not to speak blasphemous words against this holy place, and the law:
verses.pt: e apresentaram falsas testemunhas que diziam: Este homem não cessa de proferir palavras contra este santo lugar e contra a lei;
verses.en_web: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.
verses.en_bbe: And they got false witnesses who said, This man is for ever saying things against this holy place and against the law:

verses.en: For we have heard him say, that this Jesus of Nazareth shall destroy this place, and shall change the customs which Moses delivered us.
verses.pt: porque nós o temos ouvido dizer que esse Jesus, o nazareno, há de destruir este lugar e mudar os costumes que Moisés nos transmitiu.
verses.en_web: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”
verses.en_bbe: For he has said in our hearing that this Jesus of Nazareth will put this place to destruction and make changes in the rules which were handed down to us by Moses.

verses.en: And all that sat in the council, looking stedfastly on him, saw his face as it had been the face of an angel.
verses.pt: Então todos os que estavam assentados no sinédrio, fitando os olhos nele, viram o seu rosto como de um anjo.
verses.en_web: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.
verses.en_bbe: And all those who were in the Sanhedrin, looking at him, saw that his face was like the face of an angel.
